content: Rahul ji, main samajh sakti hoon ki aapke paas paise nahi hain. Lekin humein payment lena zaroori hai. Kya aap koi choti rashi abhi kar sakte hain? Ya phir kya aapne kisi aur se loan liya hai jo aap isse repay kar sakte hain?
Amit ji, hum discount ya waiver nahi de sakte. Lekin agar aap thoda sa bhi abhi kar sakein toh main uska record karwa dunga. Kya aap ₹23,000 ka payment kar sakte hain?
Rahul ji, toh main aapse ₹12,500 ka payment link WhatsApp par bhej deta hoon. Kal subah hi karein. Koi aur sawaal hai?
Amit ji, salary aane ke baad bhi agar payment nahi hota to humare paas koi aur option nahi bachta. Aapko abhi ₹46,000 ka payment dena chahiye. Kya aap iska PTP (Promise to Pay) de sakte hain?
